therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with advanced solid malignancies including hepatocellular carcinoma with varying degrees of renal or hepatic function

results.effect_size: Cmax 20.5-30.7 micromolar, AUC 437-667 micromolar*hour across hepatic function groups
biomarker_changes: Cmax ranged from 20.5-30.7 micromolar across hepatic function groups
Css ranged from 19.1-27.2 micromolar across hepatic function groups
AUC ranged from 437-667 micromolar*hour across hepatic function groups
Renal clearance decreased with hepatic impairment (6.76 L/hr normal to 0.618 L/hr moderate HI)
Percentage dose excreted in urine decreased with hepatic impairment (0.792% normal to 0.104% moderate HI)
subgroup_findings: Mild and moderate hepatic impairment showed increased exposure compared to normal function
Severe hepatic impairment showed similar or slightly decreased exposure compared to normal function
Renal clearance progressively decreased with worsening hepatic function
safety_signals: Serious adverse events included GI bleeding, abdominal pain, hyperbilirubinemia
Higher incidence of serious AEs in hepatic impairment groups

context.indication: advanced solid malignancies including hepatocellular carcinoma
